findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice short questions for Chapter 5 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Computer Science Board shape (8 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 33 questions numbered 1-33; by section: 5.1 1, 5.2 25, 5.3 7.

Covers every section in book order; every 'difference' question is answered as a two-column table; none repeats the chapter exercise (why testing is essential, the list of error types, what unit testing is, how unittest/pytest help, the purpose of test cases, how to set breakpoints, the role of watches, the step-by-step process, multiple exception types and the profiling tools are left to the exercise). Every program was run in Python 3 (tests with pytest) and its real output is given. Book corrections followed (Figure 5.1 area 15; Figure 5.2 breakpoint on a code line); Step Over is described as executing the line.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
